[P2] Allow provisional ownership metadata to be completed

A provisional context history containing only `executionArn` can be correctly enriched by collection, but every raw context snapshot is audited here when independent retirement evidence is supplied. This comparison treats an absent `ownerCaseId` as an observed `None`, so the correct final owner fails reconciliation and quarantines a fully retired target, blocking queued cases. Match by stable ID and compare only identity fields present in the prior row, while requiring complete ownership in the final snapshot. Cover provisional histories, resources, and faults followed by complete collection and retirement.
